## Chemed To Report Third Quarter 2026 Earnings October 27, Related Conference Call To Be Held On October 28


October 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM EDT


[PDF Version](https://www.chemed.com/node/23076/pdf)


CINCINNATI, Oct. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Chemed Corporation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bhejZ4asvMkYf1f2E_yMwBgFEPE1rCeXGzn9n4tx95d__gZWPLL3nJJOKiVyRHBKAgUsVhopzR54SS2Wjn3HvbsWB2dZCOQQDJF1dVUads4=) (NYSE: CHE) today announced that it will release financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, following the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange.


Chemed will host a conference call and webcast at 10 a.m., ET, on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, to discuss the company's quarterly results and to provide an update on its business.


Participants may access a live webcast of the conference call through the investor relations section of Chemed’s website,[Investor Relations Home | Chemed Corporation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=efDhV8-IIGZL5Dp4BZplNqhDUdpw2GnpesB-DbHjmYLMiiMF10uS56FJ3Mv5WXO1VRrw8lx2s4aPIK49SnQAdlHg5BI3KvNK-suaqHfyg2Bz8IQcnNMZMqI9k0Il5NFM64iVXYtXJrLE1u-PBmbEZg==) or the hosting website[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/v5gcs68f](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=P286prYYS_E91N3euJv1IE4spfQmSkMz0ChWx3L7Lmaa_s2Pa_LEX1gvecyMqGUrVvT6gU_y_JGTt50j6kMBvVvjU_OH6MRCtEKCnjoSsas5-TfufwCBGbRJlVv8PI_2McA4rKICVt619D2QcAVRF_5aKAvCbWVWN-enI0d4Wbg=) **.**


Participants may also register via teleconference at[https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BId8ccb8a390cc4b6fbb29ab2b99a55028](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=P286prYYS_E91N3euJv1IGoQXFT-S_Qj5UjglhpCDUlV8Z6NE8mPOu0J5U2mMUJm07HUYDAyfucUe8ncxsg6UOniujKSss8-PMgUcBV8wBCSM-tLZJ_cCmEIC4_olRujzb69Zy6wwcCrEuDoF13HATowBO8bRimRSsqHOln_3nH7m01TOMDuJiNnY-rdkLdF9ZaIcZCtKuBD5wb_IFiHbepg_I7nxkzwa7KC_5OytmF995y6ewfgj1gjWgX9C5f8) **.**


Once registration is completed, participants will be provided with a dial-in number containing a personalized conference code to access the call. All participants are instructed to dial-in 15 minutes prior to the start time.


A taped replay of the conference call will be available beginning approximately two hours after the call's conclusion. You may access the replay via webcast through the investor relations section of Chemed’s website.


Listed on the New York Stock Exchange and headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, Chemed Corporation ([www.chemed.com](http://www.chemed.com/) ) operates two wholly owned subsidiaries: VITAS Healthcare and Roto-Rooter. VITAS is the nation's largest provider of end-of-life hospice care and Roto-Rooter is the nation’s leading provider of plumbing and drain cleaning services.
